snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss | Story Trailer
snippet.description:
For years, Ocean-I searched the ocean floor for answers. Now, they claim to have found them.
Andrew Marsh unveils a discovery that challenges everything we thought we knew about humanity's origin, and a manned expedition is preparing to descend to comprehend it.

Pre-order Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss today at 8PM CET on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

See you in 2 days time: https://discord.gg/Nhz2grcx39.
